metadata.title: Hezb community - Build what's next
metadata.description: Hezb is a community building AI and software for real-world problems.

home.heroBody: It all started with one question: “What's next?” We bring curious people together to build useful technology for the real world.
home.heroImageAlt: A small technology community collaborating around laptops
home.storyDetail: We combine product thinking, engineering and design to turn uncertainty into a clear next step. Every engagement is shaped around the people who will use the product.
home.storyBody: Hezb is a technology community focused on AI and software, bringing builders and partners together to turn real problems into products that can run in the real world.
home.missionBody: Four principles that keep the work grounded.
home.featuredProjectsBody: Products we have built together with our customers.
home.teamBody: The people building what's next together.
mission: Build AI and software products that solve real problems for people and businesses.
Turn complex technology into experiences anyone can use.
Bring the power of AI to teams of every size, not just the giants.
Grow alongside our customers at every stage, not just deliver and disappear.
values: Automate repetitive work and give time back to what matters most.
Stable, secure, transparent products you can rely on.
Tailored solutions that scale as your needs change.
Always exploring what's new, so you stay a step ahead instead of chasing trends.

about.title: About the Hezb community
about.intro: Hezb brings people together to build AI and software products that help teams work more effectively, more simply and with confidence about what comes next.
sections: Product thinking starts by listening to the operating context before choosing technology.
A good system gives teams confidence every day instead of adding another layer of complexity.
The Hezb community stays alongside partners through discovery, build, launch and the improvement cycles after.
